title: Townsend Brown's time travel tech taken by a group in Nassau

tellings.quote: Shatskin, Brown was constantly saying that his time travel technology was taken by a group in Nassau in the Bahamas.

plain: The inventor Townsend Brown, who worked on using electricity to move objects in ways he linked to gravity, is said to have claimed again and again that his time travel technology was taken by a group in Nassau, in the Bahamas. Michels tells this himself, drawing on The Man Who Mastered Gravity, a biography of Brown by Paul Schatzkin, and on Brown's daughter, and he also names a man called William Stephenson in connection with it. If true, it would mean breakthrough technology was quietly taken out of public hands.
